brief.title: Local SEO agency introductions
brief.description: One free researched example and five additional US/Canadian local SEO agency profiles, with published business contacts, existing reporting workflows and a tailored geographic-ranking comparison.
brief.exclusions: Exclude duplicate domains and inferred contacts. Preserve agencies' existing tools and reporting services.

operator_note: Original case C0BTTA66TK3/1791868496.616779. Original buyer offer from brycembusiness2@gmail.com to support@maprank.so. Free Pro Local Builder profile and five additional distinct profiles for US$20 total. Existing parent Local SEO Bot business is explicit; no unsupported claim of zero customers. Source-qualified agency research only; agency outreach is outside this delivery.

records.geography: Wisconsin, San Francisco Bay Area and Las Vegas, United States
records.contact_instructions: Published business email: hello@prolocalbuilder.com. Business phone: 408-908-9940. The SEO page names founders Kyle in Appleton, Cesar in San Jose and Zac in Las Vegas.
records.demand: The agency offers recurring SEO for local businesses, including Google Maps work and monthly reports showing work performed and ranking changes. Its published service tiers include keyword tracking, and its founding team spans three distinct local markets.
records.current_workflow: Existing monthly SEO and ranking reporting. The public page does not identify its current tracking software.
records.fit: Compare one consenting client's priority keyword across a neighborhood grid, then place the resulting read-only branded report beside the agency's existing monthly report. The three service regions offer different city densities, so use an explicit location, grid spacing and scan date. The comparison should establish whether geographic detail and client access improve the current reporting workflow.
records.opening_message: Your SEO plans already include local rankings and a monthly account of what changed. Would one client keyword mapped across its actual service area be useful to compare with that report—using the same locations and date, with a client-readable link?
records.qualification: Confirm the current ranking tool, client permission, reporting cadence and service-area coordinates. Begin with one account; retain existing reporting and call/lead attribution during comparison.

sources.supports: Existing SEO tiers, keyword tracking, Google Maps work, monthly reporting, founders' locations and published email/phone.

records.current_workflow: The agency already publishes a location-aware tracking and monitoring service. Its current tracking product is not named on the reviewed pages.
records.fit: Compare MapRank's grid view and read-only client report against one existing location-specific keyword report. Match search phrase, business location, coordinates and observation date. Assess client readability and the effort needed to manage recurring scans across the roster, keeping citation monitoring and broader analytics in their existing systems.
records.opening_message: Your tracking service already covers map-pack visibility and location-specific keywords. Would a matched grid report for one current account help you compare neighborhood detail and the client-facing report with your existing monthly workflow?
records.qualification: Confirm its current reporting software and whether a map-grid comparison addresses a real limitation. Agree the exact business, search phrase and geography before comparing results; confirm current plan credits and cadence before scheduling ongoing scans.

records.geography: Port Orange, Florida, United States; home-service clients
records.contact_instructions: Published general agency email: hello@watsonco.marketing, displayed as hello [at] watsonco.marketing. Founder Matt Watson is named on the official About page. Business phone: 844-717-6024.
records.demand: Watson & Co serves HVAC, plumbing, electrical, landscaping and related home-service companies. Its SEO page describes monthly keyword rankings, call tracking, Google Business Profile performance and organic traffic reports, and it limits each market to one client per trade.
records.current_workflow: Existing monthly keyword, GBP, call and traffic reporting, alongside an advertised Apex AI GBP service. Preserve its one-client-per-trade-per-market operating model.
records.fit: Use one approved home-service account to compare its priority search phrase across the actual service area. A geographically explicit report can sit alongside existing calls and GBP performance in the monthly conversation. Keep the client's territory and the agency's exclusivity commitments explicit; a map scan does not replace call attribution.
records.opening_message: Your monthly home-service reports already connect keyword rankings, GBP activity and calls. Would a neighborhood-by-neighborhood view of one client's priority search help compare map visibility within its agreed service area?
records.qualification: Confirm the current local-ranking product, the client's service-area boundary and whether the comparison would change a client decision. Preserve all existing lead/call reporting and the agency's territorial exclusivity.

sources.supports: Home-service verticals, monthly reporting components and market exclusivity.

records.fit: Compare one contractor client's search phrase across several neighborhoods against its current rank report. Keep calls and lead counts in the existing report and use a consistent scan configuration for any later comparison.

records.qualification: Confirm the current tracking tool, number of locations and whether the business owner uses geographic ranking detail. Select an approved client and matching keyword/location settings before evaluating results or recurring scan cost.

records.fit: A map-grid comparison could complement its existing Rank Math Pro work with location-by-location visibility for one approved client. records.qualification: Confirm what Rank Math Pro and any other local tracker already provide for the agency. Compare only the additional geographic/client-reporting workflow and actual roster cost; preserve existing analytics and reporting.

records.geography: Fairfax and Northern Virginia, United States
records.contact_instructions: Published business email: hello@occoquandigital.com. The homepage gives a Fairfax office at 11166 Fairfax Boulevard, Suite 500 #1043 and describes its Northern Virginia service area.
records.demand: The agency offers local search visibility with ranking maps, keyword and citation tracking, GBP statistics and monthly reports. Its portfolio includes local construction and home-service businesses in Northern Virginia.
records.current_workflow: Existing local ranking maps and monthly reporting are already part of the service. The reviewed homepage does not identify the underlying tracking software.
records.fit: Start with its existing ranking-map workflow and compare one approved client over the same coordinates, spacing, keyword and observation date. Evaluate report readability, the effort to update a client roster and the recurring scan budget. A different tool is useful only if the comparison improves a concrete part of the current operation.
records.opening_message: Your local SEO service already includes ranking maps and monthly reports. Would a like-for-like grid for one Fairfax-area client help compare the reporting workflow and client-readable view with the setup you use today?
records.qualification: Ask which map-ranking tool is already in use and what the agency would want to improve. Agree an exact comparison configuration and keep citations, GBP statistics and existing reports available throughout the trial.

sources.supports: Local ranking maps, keyword/citation monitoring, GBP reporting, Northern Virginia client context, Fairfax office and published email.
